Intonation trials

Experimental pitch-contour test. Enter a word or short phrase, select the expected pattern, then record it in a quiet room. Speak in your normal voice. This tests rising, falling or level pitch; it does not validate Bikol pronunciation, word meaning or fluency.

Microphone access is requested only when you record. Pitch analysis stays on this device; audio is not stored.

The detector compares median pitch in the first and last thirds of voiced samples. A change above +2 semitones is rising, below −2 is falling, otherwise level. These thresholds are experimental and have not been validated for Bikol. Silence or insufficient voiced samples produce an unscorable trial. Speaking speed is not intonation.

Speed measurements

Run translation, Speak, and Listen trials on the translator. Translation runs from worker request to rendered result; it excludes the typing delay and includes first-use model download/index setup. STT runs from Speak to final text and includes recording and permission time; post-speech latency is recorded separately when the browser supplies that event. TTS latency runs from Listen to the first audio start; audio duration is recorded separately.

Means use successful trials only. Errors, no matches, cancelled TTS and unscorable intonation trials remain in the log. Results depend on device, browser, input length, cache and network. Keep cold-start trials separate from warm trials when reporting results.
